answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its claims fail repeated, randomly sampled work checks, and release the bond only after a long, earned track record. A sybil attacker must lock real capital in every identity and keep each one producing verifiable work; splitting one operator into a spiral of hollow accounts does not multiply useful output. A whisper of coordination may evade a single check, but repeated audits make deception costly: failed agents lose their bonds, while honest newcomers can build credibility gradually.
